SELECT * FROM EDS.MBK_CUSTOMER_STATUS_DIM
SELECT * FROM EDS.DIGITAL_CUSTOMER
SELECT * FROM EDS.BILLERS_DIM


SELECT MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.SOURCE_CODE
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.CIF_NO AS CIF_ID
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.USER_ID AS USER_NAME
	, CAST(MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.STATUS AS CHAR(2)) AS STATUS
	, MBK_CUSTOMER_STATUS_DIM.STATUS_DESCRIPTION
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.STATUS_CHANGE_DT AS STATUS_DATE
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.CREATED_DATE AS ENROLLMENT_DATE
	, SCD_START_DATE
	, SCD_END_DATE
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.INSERT_DTTM
FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB
LEFT JOIN EDS.MBK_CUSTOMER_STATUS_DIM
	ON MBK_CUSTOMER_STATUS_DIM.STATUS_CODE = MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.STATUS
